info.title: NX Hub API
info.description:
Self-hosted automation gateway for CFW Nintendo Switch consoles running sys-botbase.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The token is in `<data dir>/admin-token`.
Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code` field.
Live events: WebSocket `GET /api/events` (see docs/API.md).

get.summary: Liveness check. Does not require authentication.
Server version and whether a token is required. No authentication.
List configured Switches with live status.

put.summary: Replace a Switch's configuration. Address changes reconnect; disabling disconnects.

delete.summary: Remove a Switch (releases held inputs and disconnects first).

post.summary: Connect (and keep reconnecting). Waits up to 10 s for the attempt, then returns the status.
Release held inputs and disconnect. Auto-connect stays off until the next connect or restart.
Hand the Switch over to another program, for example a trade bot. NX Hub releases inputs, disconnects and refuses input until the lease is released or expires. Call again to renew.

delete.summary: Take the Switch back. NX Hub reconnects if it was connected before the hand-over.

get.summary: Current screen as JPEG (live view). Frames up to maxAgeMs old (default 500) are shared between viewers.
Inputs NX Hub believes are currently held.

post.summary: Press and release a button. Returns after the release has been sent.
Hold a button until released (or the safety limit expires).
Release all buttons and centre both sticks.
Release everything, then detach the virtual controller.

get.summary: The current or most recent macro run on this Switch.

post.summary: Start a macro on this Switch. One at a time; inputs are released when it ends.
Stop the running macro and release its inputs.
Run setup diagnostics. Safe: no memory access; controller only if requested.

get.summary: The most recent diagnostic report since NX Hub started.

post.summary: Save a macro: {name, description?, steps, repeat?}. repeat 0 = until stopped.

includeControllerTest.description: Also send a harmless controller update. Attaches a virtual controller to the Switch.

maxHoldMs.description: Safety limit: auto-release after this many ms. Default 30000.

holder.description: Who is taking the Switch, shown in NX Hub (for example "Trade bot"). 1–64 characters.

ttlSeconds.description: The lease ends this many seconds after the last renewal unless renewed. Default 60, range 5–3600.

durationMs.description: How long to hold before releasing, in ms. Default 100, range 20–10000.

everything.description: Release every button and centre both sticks, not just inputs NX Hub knows are held. Default true.

durationMs.description: Optional: return to centre after this many ms.

maxHoldMs.description: Safety limit when no duration is given: auto-centre after this many ms.

host.description: IP address or hostname of the Switch on your local network.

enabled.description: When true NX Hub keeps the Switch connected automatically.
